news.title: Last chance! Voting closes Friday for Pika's Best of Guam

bullets: Own the roadmap and lead projects from initial idea to launch for a key area of our creative platform.
Work closely with talented engineers, designers, and researchers to turn visionary ideas and AI advancements into delightful user experiences.
Define and track success metrics, using data, feedback, and creative insights to uncover what creators really need next.
Connect directly with creators and the Pika community to understand how generative AI inspires—and how we can go even further.
Write clear specs, rally the team, and help lead projects in our fast-moving, collaborative environment.
